source_text: However, following widespread domestic and international opposition, including from human rights organizations citing evidence of severe health complications such as hemorrhage, infection, and long-term psychological trauma associated with the procedure, the Assembly rejected the bill on July 15, 2024, preserving the criminal prohibition.
